reasons.plausibility: The proposed cryogenic rolling plus short annealing to refine the lamellae and boost strength–ductility follows established principles of thermomechanical processing in HEAs, but relies on uncertain specifics for phase stability and strain partitioning.
reasons.testability: A direct, controlled experiment comparing baseline and treated samples at various temperatures and environments can decisively confirm or refute the strengthening and ductility gains.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a concrete and focused method for improving high-entropy alloy properties under relevant aerospace conditions.
